lines.en: People say, I am the best boss.
They go, God, we've never worked in a place like this before.
And you get the best out of us.
Um, I think that pretty much sums it up.
See, we have the entire floor.
So this is my kingdom, far as the eye can see.
Ah, this is our receptionist, Pam.
Pam has been with us for forever.
If you think she's cute now, you should have seen her a couple of years ago.
How many times have I told you that there's a special filing cabinet for things from corporate?
It's called the waste paper basket.
I have an important question for you.
Oh, are you going to Angela's cat party on Sunday?
Am I going to tell them?
No, I'm not going to tell them.
I don't see the point of that.
As a doctor, you would not tell a patient if they had cancer.
Brian, uh, Howard from the temp agency.
Daniqua sent me down to start today.
I could fall and pierce an organ.
See, this is why the whole downsizing thing just doesn't bother me.
Yeah, I have no problem with that.
I have been recommending downsizing since I first got here.
I even brought it up in my interview.
Oh, this is so important, I should run to answer it.
Actually, that would be a good salary for me, don't you think?
Do you, uh, do you like the Jamie Kennedy experiment?
And punked and all that kind of stuff.
Um, you are gonna be my accomplice.
Just go along with it, okay?
So, uh, corporate just said that I don't want to --
Can you come in here for a sec?
I was gonna call you in anyway.
Um, as you know, there is going to be downsizing.
And, uh, you have made my life so much easier in that I am going to have to let you go first.
Um, what am I supposed to have stolen?
Now, I know there are some rumors out there, and I just kind of want to set the record.
Um, can you just tell me, please?
Well, I'm about to tell everybody.
Can you whisper it in my ear?
I'm just about to tell everyone.
Do you want me to tell them?
You don't know what it is.
Corporate has, uh, deemed it appropriate to enforce an ultimatum upon me.
And, uh, Jan is thinking about downsizing either the Stanford branch or this branch.
Well, you guys gotta update your resumes just like I'm doing.
I bet it's gonna be me.
You put my stuff in Jell-O again.
This is the third time, and it wasn't funny the first two times either, Jim.
Uh, but people sometimes take advantage because it's so relaxed.
I'm a volunteer sheriff's deputy on the weekends.
And you cannot screw around there.
That's sort of one of the rules.
